body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-09-29

# Summary
"AI-answer readiness, batch 2" (Sep 29, 2026), same rules as batch 1, files written with LF line endings. Summary based on script headers and after/summary.json.

# Key findings
- Posts: 13742 /5-signs-you-need-to-repipe-your-home-in-arizona/, 13708 /a-homeowners-guide-to-detecting-and-preventing-root-intrusion-in-pipes/, 13722 /signs-of-outdated-sewer-drain-pipes/, 15583 /corroded-pipes/, 15589 /how-long-do-cast-iron-pipes-last/, 14966 /cracked-vs-collapsed-sewer-pipes-whats-the-difference/ (Elementor).
- FAQ sets of 4 questions on four posts; corroded pipes and cast iron got content changes without new FAQs.
- Guarded apply script (dry run by default; live data must equal the "before" copy).

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `before/`, `after/` (content HTML, FAQ JSON, Elementor JSON for 14966, summary.json), `batch2-preview.html`, `live/`. Scripts not summarized.
